mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL , IMG_SERIAL_KEY , SCANCODE , BL , ISNULL(IMAGE_PATH_TOP, '') AS IMAGE_PATH_TOP , '' AS IMAGE_PATH_SID , CREATED , 1 AS SORT_ORDER FROM TSV_XRAY_V3.dbo.IMG_INFO WHERE BL = #{blNo} UNION ALL SELECT SERIAL , IMG_SERIAL_KEY , SCANCODE , BL , '' AS IMAGE_PATH_TOP , ISNULL(IMAGE_PATH_SID, '') AS IMAGE_PATH_SID , CREATED , 2 AS SORT_ORDER FROM TSV_XRAY_V3.dbo.IMG_INFO WHERE BL = #{blNo}

SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT SERIAL , IMG_SERIAL_KEY , SCANCODE , BL , IMAGE_PATH_TOP , IMAGE_PATH_SID , CREATED FROM TSV_XRAY_V3.dbo.IMG_INFO WHERE BL = #{blNo} AND (IMAGE_PATH_TOP != '' AND IMAGE_PATH_TOP IS NOT NULL) ) AA

SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT SERIAL , IMG_SERIAL_KEY , SCANCODE , BL , IMAGE_PATH_TOP , IMAGE_PATH_SID , CREATED FROM TSV_XRAY_V3.dbo.IMG_INFO WHERE BL = #{blNo} AND (IMAGE_PATH_SID != '' AND IMAGE_PATH_SID IS NOT NULL) ) AA

SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT il.BL , bi.IN_NO , bi.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , bi.IN_APPROVAL_NO , bi.BL_NO , bi.MBL_NO , bi.AR_DATE , bi.CARRYIN_DATE , CASE WHEN LEN(bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) > 15 THEN ( SUBSTRING(bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) ) ELSE SUBSTRING(bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) END AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP FROM TSV_XRAY_V3.dbo.IMG_INFO il LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN bi WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.BL_NO = il.BL WHERE il.BL = #{srchNo} ) AA
